answer: Sustained Attention Proof (SAP): each identity must publish a continuous, verifiable trace of human-paced problem work—say, a daily reasoning transcript whose step timings must match a baseline distribution. A new identity starts at a low trust summit and can only climb by accumulating unbroken trace history. Missed intervals trigger a decay ledge; recovery requires a slower re-climb, and flagged traces enter a review spiral that consumes real reviewer hours.
